item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We work to prevent that outcome. We need a ban on superintelligence—not a race to build it first.

2. We cannot protect humanity by racing to build the thing that will destroy it. Superintelligence built with anything like current techniques will kill everyone on Earth. We call for a ban before anyone crosses that line.

3. We want a future with people in it. That means stopping superintelligence: if anyone builds it with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We work for a ban because no company or government has the right to gamble away humanity.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We begin with the fact that makes our work necessary: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that outcome as the inevitable price of technological progress. We work toward a ban on superintelligence because humanity’s future is not something any company or government has the right to wager. We do not need to win a race toward extinction. We need to stop it. That means building public understanding, demanding political action, and making prevention the goal of policy. We have a future worth protecting, and we intend to fight for it.
